name: Windows System Snapshot
summary: Creates a concise inventory of Windows, hardware, uptime, storage, and network-adapter state.
collects: Windows edition, version, architecture, and last boot time
Computer manufacturer, model, processor, and memory
Volume capacity and network-adapter status
privacy_note: The report contains the computer name, model, internal network addresses, and adapter identifiers. Remove identifying details before sharing outside your support team.

name: Performance Diagnostic Report
summary: Captures high-resource processes, memory availability, storage space, uptime, and recent system errors.
collects: Top processes by processor time and memory use
Available memory, uptime, and volume free space
Recent critical and error events from the System log
privacy_note: Process names and event messages can reveal applications, usernames, file paths, and organization details. Review the report before sharing.

name: Network Connectivity Report
summary: Records adapter, IP, gateway, DNS, route, and optional approved-host connectivity evidence.
collects: Network adapter and IP configuration
Default routes and configured DNS servers
Optional DNS and TCP 443 test to a host you specify
privacy_note: The report includes internal IP addresses, DNS servers, gateways, interface names, and possibly a tested hostname. Treat it as internal diagnostic information.

name: Disk Space Assessment
summary: Summarizes volume capacity and the largest top-level user-profile folders without deleting content.
collects: Volume capacity, free space, and health status
Approximate size of top-level folders in the current user profile
Windows temporary-folder size without listing individual files
privacy_note: The report includes user-profile paths and folder names. It does not list individual filenames, but paths may still identify a user.

name: Application Crash Evidence Collector
summary: Collects recent application errors and Windows Error Reporting events for a named application.
collects: Matching recent Application log errors
Windows Error Reporting events
Application name, collection time, and Windows version
privacy_note: Crash messages may contain usernames, file paths, document names, server names, or application data. Carefully inspect the report before sharing.

name: Printer Diagnostic Report
summary: Captures installed printer, port, driver, queue, and Print Spooler evidence without changing a queue.
collects: Installed printer status, drivers, ports, and sharing state
Current queued jobs and their status
Print Spooler service status and recent print-service errors
privacy_note: Printer, server, and queued document names can be sensitive. Remove document names and internal server details before external sharing.

name: Clear a Stuck Print Queue
summary: Previews and removes queued jobs from one printer without restarting the Print Spooler or affecting other queues.
collects: Verifies the selected printer exists
Shows every job targeted for removal
Removes only jobs from the named printer after confirmation
changes: Permanently removes all queued jobs from the selected printer
Does not remove the printer, driver, port, or jobs in other queues

parameters.name: PrinterName
parameters.description: Exact installed printer name shown by Get-Printer.

dry_run: Add -WhatIf to preview the jobs that would be removed without changing the queue.
rollback: Removed print jobs cannot be restored. The original documents must be submitted again if still needed.

permissions.notes: Users can normally remove their own print jobs. Other users' jobs may require administrator or print-management rights.

privacy_note: The preview may display queued document names. Treat those names as potentially sensitive.

name: Restart a Selected Windows Service
summary: Safely previews and restarts one explicitly named Windows service after validating its current state.
collects: Verifies the selected service exists
Displays its current status and display name
Restarts only the selected service after confirmation
changes: Temporarily stops and starts the selected service
Applications or features that depend on the service may be interrupted

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: Windows service name—not the display name—confirmed with Get-Service.

dry_run: Add -WhatIf to preview the restart without stopping the service.
rollback: A service restart cannot be undone. If it does not return to Running, record the error and use its documented recovery or escalation procedure.

permissions.notes: Restarting most Windows services requires an elevated PowerShell session.

privacy_note: Service names are usually low sensitivity, but organization-specific service names can reveal installed management or security software.

name: Map a Network Drive
summary: Validates a UNC path and maps it to an available drive letter with an optional persistent sign-in mapping.
collects: Validates the requested drive letter is available
Tests whether the UNC path is reachable
Creates only the requested mapping after confirmation
changes: Adds a network-drive mapping for the current user
Can persist the mapping across sign-ins when -Persist is supplied

parameters.name: DriveLetter
parameters.description: One unused letter from D through Z.

parameters.name: Persist
parameters.description: Keeps the mapping across future sign-ins.

dry_run: Add -WhatIf to validate the inputs and preview the mapping without creating it.
rollback: Run Remove-PSDrive -Name X, replacing X with the mapped letter. For a persistent mapping, confirm it also disappears from File Explorer.

permissions.notes: Standard user access is normally sufficient, but the account must have permission to the network share.

privacy_note: Server names, share paths, and drive-letter conventions may reveal internal infrastructure. Do not embed passwords in the script or command line.
